7487-8043-8350.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
7487-8043-8350.description:
Cast Face Yourself for free due to Vision, targeting yourself and creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste and the noted exile clause.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Zealous Lorecaster token enters, it triggers, returning Face Yourself from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2390-6191-7289.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2390-6191-7289.description:
Gain life.
Leonardo triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
All Will Be One triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

3099-3360-6006.description:
Activate Torchling by tapping it, adding {R}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Torchling by paying {R}, untapping it.
Repeat.
3099-3360-6006.notes: Once you have infinite green mana, you may activate Leyline of Abundance any number of times, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on creatures you control.

4247-4694-4802-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
4247-4694-4802-7306.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Biomancer.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 1.

1479-2692-2841-8105.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Escape Tunnel.
1479-2692-2841-8105.description:
Fetch a land using Escape Tunnel.
When the fetched land enters, Felidar Retreat and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Felidar Retreat trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Felidar Retreat from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Felidar Retreat triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

3899-7804--5.notablePrerequisites: The top card of your library is a nonland card.
3899-7804--5.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Captain Kathryn Janeway triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat

1829-1981-2415-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Vindictive Vampire and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Vindictive Vampire trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving them indestructible until end of turn.
Repeat.

252-4231-5394-7295.easyPrerequisites:
You control another artifact creature.
You have a way to kill the additional artifact creature.
252-4231-5394-7295.description:
Cause another artifact creature you control to die.
When the artifact creature dies, Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue, Food and Treasure token due to Academy Manufactor.
As the Clue, Food and Treasure enter, they each become 7/7 Dinosaur artifact creatures in addition to their other types due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5686-6972-7726.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Virtuous Variant.
When Virtuous Variant dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Virtuous Variant enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

1274-7399-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-7399-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Bogwater Lumaret triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-1329-1414-7296.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Lotus Petal from your graveyard.
Cast Lotus Petal by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

141-780-4050.description:
Cast Supernatural Stamina by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Supernatural Stamina, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Supernatural Stamina.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

141-997-3440.description:
Cast Demonic Gifts by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Demonic Gifts, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Demonic Gifts.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Woe Strider abilities from step 5.

5696-5702-6968.notablePrerequisites:
You have cast your commander from the command zone at least twice.
You have a way to cause a land to enter the battlefield under your control.
5696-5702-6968.description:
Cause a land to enter the battlefield under your control. Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Jyoti.
Put the token Jyoti into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The token Jyoti's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Forest Dryad land creature token for each time you've cast your commander from the command zone this game.
When the Forest Dryads enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers that many times.
Holding priority, activate two Forest Dryads by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Repeat step 6 until there is only one Springheart Nantuko trigger remaining.
Resolve the final Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Jyoti.
Repeat from step 2.

1387-1500-2633-3940-5644.description:
Cast Haze of Rage with buyback by paying {R}. Urabrask, Blood Funnel, Haze of Rage's storm ability and Judith trigger.
Resolve the Urabrask trigger, adding {R} and dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Judith trigger, creating a 2/2 Imp creature token.
Resolve the Blood Funnel trigger, causing you to sacrifice the Imp.
When the Imp dies, it triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Haze of Rage trigger, copying it for each spell cast before it this turn.
Resolve all Haze of Rage spells.
Repeat.

3330-4017-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3330-4017-5641.description:
Gain life.
Basking Broodscale triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-3490-6638.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
2034-3490-6638.description:
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Tidus triggers, either putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

488-874-4708-4986-5754.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
One of either Dark Sphere or Delif's Cone must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
488-874-4708-4986-5754.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Phlage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Phlage enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities and Loran trigger.
Resolve the first Phlage trigger, sacrificing it.
Resolve the second Phlage trigger, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to gain 3 life.
Resolve the Loran trigger, returning the other {0} cost artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1.
Activate the {0} cost artifact by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

2364-2538-5911.notablePrerequisites:
You have a nonland artifact card in hand that can be cast using {C}{C} or less.
You have no other cards in hand.
2364-2538-5911.description:
Activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying its mana cost.
Flubs triggers, causing you to return Mana Vault from the battlefield to your hand, and causing each opponent to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast Mana Vault by paying its mana cost.
Flubs triggers, causing you to return the artifact cast in step 3 from the battlefield to your hand, and causing each opponent to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind.
Repeat.

645-1267-3908-3967.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
645-1267-3908-3967.description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {U/B}{U/B} to return Spark Double from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking as a nonlegendary copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Deal combat damage using Spark Double.
Spark Double triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Spark Double
Repeat each turn.

112-565-1434-6203.manaNeeded: {3}{U} if Throne of Eldraine's chosen color is not "Blue"
112-565-1434-6203.description:
If able, activate Throne of Eldraine's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}{U} that can only be spent to cast blue monocolored spells.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, targeting Throne of Eldraine.
Orvar's first ability triggers, creating a copy of Throne of Eldraine. Choose "Blue" as its color as it enters the battlefield.
Resolve Clockspinning, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature with Mana Cost Equal to {0}

1940-2882-4128-4662--1.notablePrerequisites: Infinite Reflection attached to Unstable Shapeshifter.
1940-2882-4128-4662--1.description:
Discard a card to activate Unstable Shapeshifter's ability from Chainer, allowing you to cast a creature spell from your graveyard this turn.
Cast a creature spell from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Due to Infinite Reflection, that creature enters the battlefield as a copy of Unstable Shifter copying Chainer.
Put that creature in the graveyard due to the legend rule.
That creature entering the battlefield and dying triggers its own Chainer ability, Unstable Shapeshifter's Chainer ability, and Unstable Shapeshifter's original ability.
Resolve the two Chainer triggers, failing to grant anything haste.
Resolve the Liliana trigger, drawing a card.
Resolve the Unstable Shapeshifter ability, causing it to become a new copy of Chainer that has not yet activated its ability this turn.
Repeat.

2084-4753.notablePrerequisites: Clever Impersonator is a copy of Mirror-Mad Phantasm.
2084-4753.description: Activate Clever Impersonator by paying {1}{U}, shuffling Clever Impersonator into your library and milling your entire library due to it not having a card named Mirror-Mad Phantasm in it.

1628-5641.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
1628-5641.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Necrosynthesis triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 2.

4222-4289-5467.easyPrerequisites: Freed from the Real attached to Wylie Duke.
4222-4289-5467.notablePrerequisites: Wylie Duke does not have summoning sickness.
4222-4289-5467.description:
Activate Wylie Duke by tapping it, adding {U}.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Wylie Duke.
Repeat.

11-1980-5195.notablePrerequisites:
You have another instant and/or sorcery card in hand that can be cast using four or less colored mana.
You have enough mana to cast the additional instant or sorcery.
11-1980-5195.description:
Cast any other instant or sorcery spell by paying its mana cost.
Swarm Intelligence and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Swarm Intelligence trigger, copying the spell.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the copy of the instant or sorcery.
Holding priority, activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{U}.
Cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting the spell cast in step 1.
Swarm Intelligence and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Swarm Intelligence trigger, copying Narset's Reversal, with the copy targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying Narset's Reversal with the copy targeting the spell cast in step 1, and then returning the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Narset's Reversal copy, copying the spell it is targeting and returning the original spell to your hand.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the copy of the spell.
Activate any number of Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding enough mana to cast the additional instant or sorcery.
Repeat.
If the additional spell can be cast for less than four mana, this combo nets infinite mana, which may be used to repeat this combo targeting any other instant and/or sorcery card in your hand and/or on the stack.

1337-2534-4875.notablePrerequisites:
Tolsimir Wolfblood does not have summoning sickness.
"Pirate" chosen with Conspiracy.
1337-2534-4875.description:
Activate Tolsimir Wolfblood by tapping it, creating a 2/2 Voja legendary creature token.
If you control two Voja tokens, put one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Coercive Recruiter triggers, untapping Tolsimir Wolfblood.
Repeat.

2645-4657-5234.notablePrerequisites:
Magus of the Candelabra does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least five mana-producing lands.
2645-4657-5234.description:
Activate five lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}.
Heartbeat of Spring triggers five times, adding at least {5}.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {5} and tapping it, untapping five lands.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Magus of the Candelabra.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Staff of Domination.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities.
